method: Three read-only host CPU counter samples at two-second spacing; NVIDIA-SMI utilization/memory query; Windows free-memory query; local listener check on port 8001. The experiment launcher was not invoked.
rejection_reasons: Host CPU mean and maximum exceeded the frozen limits
GPU utilization exceeded the frozen limit
Free system memory was below the frozen minimum
interpretation: The unchanged resource gate rejected this host state before any model artifact access. This is a host-state observation, not task or protocol evidence.
